[[File:zabrakvibroblade.png|thumb|right|170px|A Zabrak vibroblade.]]

The '''Zabrak vibroblade''' was a type of [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] believed to be constructed by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], although rarely seen to be used by them. This weapon was finely balanced and many Zabrak believed that their skill in combat made the use of this particular vibroblade unnecessary. Similarly to other [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], the blade was protected by a [[cortosis-weave]] to minimize damage from [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].
